Before Hollywood, I was living in a van in Hawaii and waiting tables at Bubba Gump Shrimp Company. One day, the incredible Rae Dawn Chong walked into the restaurant, and naturally, I went up to her table and said, “Hey, you’re a movie star! What are you doing here?”

She asked if I could act, and I said, “Fuck yeah, put me in your movie!”

She asked for my phone number. The only problem was I didn’t have one. So I gave her my buddy Mike’s number instead. A couple days later, Mike casually mentions, “Oh, by the way, someone called you.” ARE YOU KIDDING ME, MIKE?!

I called her back, and sure enough, she was serious. I drove over to pick up the script, went back to Mike’s house, and read all 120 pages three times in a row. First script I’d ever read. My character's name was Devon, and I remember thinking, “Sweet! I could totally play a Devon!”

I showed up to the audition with every line and inflection mapped out in pencil. Rae told me I could act and offered me the part. I asked if we were shooting in Hawaii. Nope. Los Angeles.

I had about $60 to my name, a bag of clothes, and some rollerblades.

Then Rae told me they'd fly me out. And I remember thinking right then and there, my life just changed forever. I'm going to be an actor.

That little movie was Cursed Part 3, a low-budget horror comedy that opened the door to Hollywood for me.

I'll forever be grateful to Rae for taking a chance on a kid working at a shrimp restaurant. Everybody starts somewhere, and this is where it all began for me.

🚨 BREAKING: $2.7 BILLION JUST MOVED OUT OF BINANCE IN 24 SECONDS.

Everyone is screaming HACK.

But the onchain evidence tells a VERY different story.

And this could be the biggest misunderstanding in crypto right now.

Here's what happened.

At 20:24:23 UTC, Binance 14 transferred $2.53 BILLION across 64 tokens.

Just 24 seconds later, another Binance hot wallet sent $174.4 MILLION to the exact same destination.

TOTAL: $2,701,600,000.

The transfers reportedly included:

• $1.67B USDT
• $454.1M ETH
• $88.5M RLUSD
• $77.1M wBETH
• $50.5M XAUt
• $50.4M UNI
• $43.9M ENA
• $38.1M PEPE
• $29.7M LINK
• $27.7M USD1

NOW HERE'S WHERE THINGS GET INTERESTING.

The receiving wallet was created TODAY.

No previous transaction history.

And suddenly, it received $2.7 BILLION.

Sounds terrifying, right?

But there's a detail almost everyone is ignoring.

At the time of the analysis, the receiving wallet hadn't sent those funds to mixers, exchanges or unrelated addresses.

Another Binance-labeled hot wallet also transferred funds to that same destination.

And the original wallet reportedly continued operating 16 minutes later.

That looks more consistent with a coordinated internal wallet migration than a typical theft.

BUT THERE'S ONE RED FLAG.

At 20:41 UTC, the same relayer reportedly attempted another transfer involving 780 MILLION USDC.

That transaction failed.

And it deserves further investigation.

Meanwhile, the market is already reacting.

$BNB: -8.6%
$ETH: -4.0%
$BTC: -2.7%

Billions moving.

Traders panicking.

Rumors spreading everywhere.

But suspicious transfers alone DO NOT prove a hack.

HERE'S THE WALLET I'M WATCHING:

0x5227f603c1ee34ce3c06efe6477003bdfccb2f8c

If those funds start moving toward mixers or unrelated destinations, the situation becomes much more concerning.

Until then, I'm treating this as an unconfirmed security incident, not a confirmed $2.7 BILLION theft.

SAVE THIS ADDRESS.

The next transactions could tell us far more than the headlines.

EBONYI STATE: SECURITY, CORRUPTION, NATIONAL UNITY AND THE DIGNITY OF EVERY NIGERIAN

My grassroots sensitisation tour brought me to Ebonyi, the Salt State, today, 29th October 2026, following yesterday’s visit to Akwanga, Nasarawa State, as our nationwide Town Hall Series continues.

In Ebonyi, I made a stop at Nkalagu and Ezillo to greet and acknowledge our supporters and briefly visited the market in Ezillo, where I interacted with our hardworking women who trade and bring farm produce to market.

In Abakaliki, I joined our party supporters on a road walk to the venue of our town hall meeting.

At the town hall, participants raised concerns about insecurity, particularly kidnapping and banditry; corruption; government borrowing; and the deteriorating condition of our hospitals, schools, and other essential amenities.

The most touching contribution came from a participant representing persons living with disabilities, who spoke about the challenges they face and the apparent lack of adequate support from government and society.

I assured the participants that, upon election, our foremost priorities will be to unite the country, decisively tackle insecurity and confront corruption, while pulling our people out of poverty.

To our brothers and sisters living with disabilities, I reiterated that the compassion of a nation is measured by how it treats its most vulnerable citizens. We will work with state governments to ensure their inclusion, proper care and dignity.

We will also invest massively in education and healthcare, including at least one fully functional primary healthcare centre in every political ward across Nigeria, while working to reduce the cost of living and expand opportunities for all.

I sincerely thank the participants, our party members, the organisers and the good people of Ebonyi State for their warm reception, enthusiasm and active participation.
